answer: The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in tide, expire in jade, and canyon lists each expiry. An attacker running 113 aliases therefore needs 105 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3995 identities would post 1287 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
